name: merge-to-main-plugin
description: A safe merge-to-main workflow with project-aware checks, Conventional Commits, documentation updates, and post-deploy verification.

interface.longDescription: Runs project-aware pre-merge checks, updates related documentation, creates Conventional Commits, waits for CI, and verifies deployments before considering a merge complete.
